records.definitionValue: fun a => ∑ i, Polynomial.C (a i) * Polynomial.X ^ ↑i

records.type:
∀ (n : ℕ) (a : ℚ) (W : ℚ[X]),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.constantTerm n (a • W) = a * ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.constantTerm n W

∀ (n s : ℕ) (a : ℚ) (W : ℚ[X]),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n s (a • W) = a * ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n s W

∀ (a b : Fin 5 → ℚ),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.coordinatePolynomial (a + b) =
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.coordinatePolynomial a + ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.coordinatePolynomial b

∀ (c : ℚ) (a : Fin 5 → ℚ),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.coordinatePolynomial (c • a) =
    c • ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.coordinatePolynomial a
∀ (a : Fin 5 → ℚ) (i : Fin 5), (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.coordinatePolynomial a).coeff ↑i = a i

records.definitionValue:
fun n W i =>
  match ↑i with
  | 0 => ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.constantTerm n W
  | 1 => ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 3 W
  | 2 => ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 5 W
  | 3 => ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 7 W
  | x => ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 9 W

records.type: ∀ (a : Fin 5 → ℚ) (k : ℕ), 5 ≤ k → (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.coordinatePolynomial a).coeff k = 0

records.definitionValue: fun n => { toFun := ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.aggregate n, map_add' := ⋯, map_smul' := ⋯ }

records.type:
∀ (n : ℕ) (a : Fin 5 → ℚ),
  (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.quarticAggregateLinearMap n) a =
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.aggregate n (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.coordinatePolynomial a)

∀ (n s : ℕ) (W V : ℚ[X]),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n s (W + V) =
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n s W + ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n s V

∀ (n : ℕ),
  Even n →
    ∀ (W : ℚ[X]),
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapReflection.StrongProperMultiplier n W →
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.aggregate n W = 0 →
          ∀ (s : ℕ), 1 ≤ s → s ≤ 9 → ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n s W = 0

∀ (n : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.aggregate n W = 0 → ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.exactL n W = 0

∀ (n : ℕ) (W V : ℚ[X]),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.constantTerm n (W + V) =
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.constantTerm n W + ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.constantTerm n V

∀ (n : ℕ) (a : ℚ) (W : ℚ[X]),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.aggregate n (a • W) = a • ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.aggregate n W

∀ (n : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.aggregate n W = 0 ↔
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.constantTerm n W = 0 ∧
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 3 W = 0 ∧
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 5 W = 0 ∧
          ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 7 W = 0 ∧ ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 9 W = 0

∀ (n j s : ℕ) (a : ℚ) (W : ℚ[X]),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n j s (a • W) =
    a * ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n j s W

∀ (n j s : ℕ) (W V : ℚ[X]),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n j s (W + V) =
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n j s W +
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n j s V

∀ (n : ℕ) (W V : ℚ[X]),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.aggregate n (W + V) =
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.aggregate n W + ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.aggregate n V

∀ (n : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.aggregate n W 0 = ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.constantTerm n W ∧
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.aggregate n W 1 = ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 3 W ∧
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.aggregate n W 2 = ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 5 W ∧
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.aggregate n W 3 = ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 7 W ∧
          ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.aggregate n W 4 = ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 9 W

∀ (n : ℕ),
  2 ≤ n →
    Even n →
      ∀ (W : ℚ[X]),
        W.natDegree ≤ 4 →
          ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.aggregate n W = 0 →
            ∀ (s : ℕ),
              1 ≤ s →
                s ≤ 9 → ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n j s W = 0

∀ (n : ℕ),
  2 ≤ n →
    Even n →
      ∀ (W : ℚ[X]),
        W.natDegree ≤ 4 →
          ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.aggregate n W = 0 →
            HasSum (fun t => ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.weightedR n W ↑(t + 1))) 0

∀ (n : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.aggregate n W 0 =
    -∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        ∑ s ∈ Finset.Icc 1 9,
          ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n j s W * ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s j

∀ (n : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.aggregate n W 1 =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n j 3 W ∧
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.aggregate n W 2 =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n j 5 W ∧
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.aggregate n W 3 =
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n j 7 W ∧
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.aggregate n W 4 =
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n j 9 W

∀ (n : ℕ) (a b : ℚ) (W V : ℚ[X]),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.aggregate n (a • W + b • V) =
    a • ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.aggregate n W + b • ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.aggregate n V

∀ (n : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]),
  W.natDegree ≤ 4 →
    (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.aggregate n W = 0 ↔
      (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.quarticAggregateLinearMap n)
          (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.polynomialCoordinates W) =
        0)

∀ (n : ℕ),
  Even n →
    ∀ (W : ℚ[X]),
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapReflection.StrongProperMultiplier n W →
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.aggregate n W = 0 →
          HasSum (fun k => ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.weightedR n W ↑(k + 1))) 0

∀ (n : ℕ),
  Even n →
    ∀ (W : ℚ[X]),
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapReflection.StrongProperMultiplier n W →
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.aggregate n W = 0 →
          ∀ (s : ℕ),
            1 ≤ s → s ≤ 9 → ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n j s W = 0

extra_helper_records.type:
∀ (n : ℕ) (t : ℚ),
  Polynomial.eval t (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.baseNumerator n) = ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.numerator n t

∀ (n : ℕ) (t : ℚ),
  Polynomial.eval t (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.polePolynomial n) = ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.poleProduct n t
∀ (n : ℕ) (t : ℚ), (∀ k ≤ n, t + ↑k ≠ 0) → Polynomial.eval t (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.polePolynomial n) ≠ 0

∀ (n j : ℕ) (t : ℚ),
  j ≤ n →
    Polynomial.eval t (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.polePolynomial n) =
      (t + ↑j) * Polynomial.eval t (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapPartialFractions.clearedPolePolynomial n j)

∀ (n : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]) (t : ℚ),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.weightedR n W t =
    Polynomial.eval t (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.weightedNumerator n W) /
      Polynomial.eval t (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.polePolynomial n) ^ 9

∀ (n j s : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]) (t : ℚ),
  j ≤ n →
    1 ≤ s →
      s ≤ 9 →
        (∀ k ≤ n, t + ↑k ≠ 0) →
          ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n j s W *
                  Polynomial.eval t (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapPartialFractions.clearedPolePolynomial n j) ^ 9 *
                (t + ↑j) ^ (9 - s) /
              Polynomial.eval t (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.polePolynomial n) ^ 9 =
            ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n j s W / (t + ↑j) ^ s

∀ (n : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.ProperMultiplier n W →
    ∀ (t : ℚ),
      (∀ k ≤ n, t + ↑k ≠ 0) →
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.weightedR n W t =
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
            ∑ s ∈ Finset.Icc 1 9, ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n j s W / (t + ↑j) ^ s

∀ (s T : ℕ),
  ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s (T + 1) = ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s T + 1 / ↑(T + 1) ^ s

∀ (s T j : ℕ),
  ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, 1 / (↑t + ↑j) ^ s =
    ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s (T + j) - ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s j

∀ (n T : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.ProperMultiplier n W →
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.finiteL n T W =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        ∑ s ∈ Finset.Icc 1 9,
          ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n j s W *
            (ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s (T + j) - ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s j)

∀ (n T : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.ProperMultiplier n W →
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.finiteL n T W =
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.constantTerm n W +
          ∑ s ∈ Finset.Icc 1 9,
            ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n s W * ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s T +
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.shiftedTail n T W

∀ (n T : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.ProperMultiplier n W →
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 1 W = 0 →
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.finiteL n T W =
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.constantTerm n W +
            ∑ s ∈ Finset.Icc 2 9,
              ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n s W * ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s T +
          ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.shiftedTail n T W

∀ (n T : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.ProperMultiplier n W →
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 1 W = 0 →
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 2 W = 0 →
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 4 W = 0 →
          ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 6 W = 0 →
            ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 8 W = 0 →
              ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.finiteL n T W =
                ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.constantTerm n W +
                    (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 3 W * ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower 3 T +
                          ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 5 W * ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower 5 T +
                        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 7 W * ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower 7 T +
                      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 9 W * ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower 9 T) +
                  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.shiftedTail n T W

∀ (s T j : ℕ),
  ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s (T + j) - ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s T =
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 j, 1 / (↑T + ↑k) ^ s
∀ (n : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ (W : ℚ[X]), W.natDegree ≤ 4 → ZetaNine.CoefficientMapReflection.StrongProperMultiplier n W

∀ (n T : ℕ),
  Even n →
    ∀ (W : ℚ[X]),
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapReflection.StrongProperMultiplier n W →
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.finiteL n T W =
          ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.constantTerm n W +
              (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 3 W * ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower 3 T +
                    ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 5 W * ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower 5 T +
                  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 7 W * ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower 7 T +
                ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 9 W * ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower 9 T) +
            ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.shiftedTail n T W
∀ (T : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ), ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, f t = ∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, f (t + 1)
∀ (s T : ℕ), ↑(ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s T) = ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, 1 / ↑t ^ s
∀ (s T : ℕ), 1 ≤ s → ↑(ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s T) = ∑ t ∈ Finset.range (T + 1), 1 / ↑t ^ s
∀ (s : ℕ), 1 < s → ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.zetaReal s = ∑' (t : ℕ), 1 / ↑t ^ s

∀ (s : ℕ),
  1 < s →
    Filter.Tendsto (fun T => ↑(ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s T)) Filter.atTop
      (nhds (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.zetaReal s))
∀ (s k : ℕ), 1 ≤ s → Filter.Tendsto (fun T => 1 / (↑T + ↑k) ^ s) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

∀ (s j : ℕ),
  1 ≤ s →
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun T => ↑(ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s (T + j) - ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s T))
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

∀ (n : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]),
  Filter.Tendsto (fun T => ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.shiftedTail n T W)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

∀ (n : ℕ),
  Even n →
    ∀ (W : ℚ[X]),
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapReflection.StrongProperMultiplier n W →
        Filter.Tendsto (fun T => ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.finiteL n T W)) Filter.atTop
          (nhds (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.exactL n W))
∀ (j : ℕ), Summable fun t => 1 / (↑t + 1 + ↑j) - 1 / (↑t + 1)
∀ (j s : ℕ), 2 ≤ s → Summable fun t => 1 / (↑t + 1 + ↑j) ^ s

∀ (n : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.ProperMultiplier n W →
    ∀ (t : ℕ),
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.actualSeries n W t =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
          ∑ s ∈ Finset.Icc 1 9, ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n j s W) / (↑t + 1 + ↑j) ^ s

∀ (n : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapReflection.StrongProperMultiplier n W →
    ∀ (t : ℕ),
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.actualSeries n W t =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
            ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n j 1 W) * (1 / (↑t + 1 + ↑j) - 1 / (↑t + 1)) +
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
            ∑ s ∈ Finset.Icc 2 9, ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n j s W) / (↑t + 1 + ↑j) ^ s

∀ (n : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapReflection.StrongProperMultiplier n W →
    Summable (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.actualSeries n W)

∀ (n T : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]),
  ∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.actualSeries n W t =
    ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.finiteL n T W)

∀ (n : ℕ),
  Even n →
    ∀ (W : ℚ[X]),
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapReflection.StrongProperMultiplier n W →
        HasSum (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.actualSeries n W) (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.exactL n W)
